notes: David Wiley (Lumen Learning), 'OER, the 5Rs, and Creative Commons: The Shortest Possible Introduction', a public Google Slides deck licensed CC BY (its own title slide says so), exported with Google Slides' PDF export (720 x 405 pt, Roboto, grey text). Scored: slides 1-3: a slide title (h1) over a numbered list whose first item holds two '-' items at depth 1 with an unmarked 'or' line between them (kept in the first '-' item), the last item highlighted yellow (a highlight: the model has no field for it yet), the title slide (the deck's title, a centered subtitle and two centered credit lines, 'CC BY' underlined and linked), and a slide title over three '●' items with wrapped lines. Arrows '→' come from Arial inside Roboto lines. Alignment (round 2, measured with PyMuPDF): blocks 2 are centered: each line's middle lies within 4 pt of its column's middle and both its ends stand more than 8 pt inside the column's margins (a column's margin is where three or more of its lines end, or its furthest line end).
